draft.transcript:
This is Samuel Kariuki, Director of Digital and Data Systems, with the Q2 update.
We're sitting at eighty-five percent complete against our roadmap for this quarter, which I'm pleased with.
Our key success was migrating the legacy SharePoint list structure to the new schema without any data loss - that was a genuinely tricky piece of work and the team pulled it off cleanly.
The main challenge has been getting timely sign-off from the information security team on the new data classification policy - we've been waiting five weeks now and it's starting to hold up two dependent workstreams.
On support, at this stage we don't need anything additional from corporate - we're managing the escalation ourselves.
I think that covers everything for this quarter.
